messages:
olivia: Quick report from an onboarding run: sampleapp (node) hits a reshape error when chaining embeddings -> rerank. Some candidate embeddings are one float short and the UI crashes.

peter: Oof. Which SDK version and model? Any raw dumps with REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG enabled?

olivia: node-sdk@1.3.0, sampleapp tag redwood/quickstart:latest, model=openembed-medium-2025-11. I enabled REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG and saw mixed lengths in the same response. Raw snippet: `{'candidates':[{'id':'x','vector':[...<1023 floats>]}, {'id':'y','vector':[...<1024 floats>}]}`.

mike: Are you seeing any auth retries (401/403) around that time? Retries during streaming can cause concat bugs.

olivia: yes, there was a flurry of 401s in the container right before the bad response. The SDK logs show a retry but no error thrown.

sdk-team: thanks for the details. Hypothesis: autobatcher concat optimization + retry semantics. If the first stream attempt yields a partial chunk and a retry starts, the two attempts may be stitched leading to off-by-one float counts. Also we've had a recent field rename between `vector` and `embedding` which could complicate parsers.

peter: Can you reproduce with autobatch disabled? `client.rerank.batch(..., autobatch: false)` or set env `REDWOOD_AUTOBATCH=false`. That will avoid the optimized concat path.

olivia: disabling autobatch fixed it in my run. Manual batching works. Thanks.

sdk-team: short-term plan: 1) Add a defensive assertion in the SDK to check all candidate embeddings have identical length and log the request-id when they don’t. 2) Normalize both `vector` and `embedding` fields into a single in-memory name so mixed responses don't break consumers. 3) Change retry behavior so we only retry before streaming/consuming the body; avoid combining partial bodies.

ciara-bot: incident created: INC-2026-338 embed-rerank-autobatch-concat (priority: medium)

mike: Product note: update quickstart to pin a safe SDK version and include a troubleshooting bullet: "If you encounter mismatch, try REDWOOD_AUTOBATCH=false and set REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1."

sdk-team: we'll cut a hotfix today for the length assertion + normalization and follow up with a retry semantics change. Also adding an e2e that simulates streaming retry + mixed field names so it doesn't regress.

olivia: that'll save future onboardees. I'll update the onboarding doc after the hotfix is out.

sdk-team: thanks for reporting and the repro steps. Please share the request-id if you see this again so we can trace the gateway logs.
